summary: This topic explains how to view outstanding fee amounts (dues) for students, with various filtering options including by class, month, fee head, course, session, and even by a specific amount or percentage of the due.
navigation: Fee > Fee Reports > Due Fee Report
Fee > Fee Reports > Multi-Session Due Fee Report
steps: Select either 'Due Fee Report' or 'Multi-Session Due Fee Report'.
- Course (for course-wise dues, useful for teachers)
- Session (for 'Multi-Session Due Fee Report' to view dues across academic years)
- 'Enter Amount' or 'Enter Percentage' (to filter for dues above a certain value or percentage).
Click 'Go' to generate the report based on the applied filters.
business_rules: The report displays all pending or outstanding fee amounts.
The 'Multi-Session Due Fee Report' allows for viewing dues across multiple academic sessions.
Filtering by amount or percentage is useful for identifying students with significant outstanding dues for targeted communication.
important_notes: Teachers can use the course-wise filter to check dues specifically for students in their assigned courses.
The amount/percentage filter helps in prioritizing follow-up actions, such as sending messages to parents with high outstanding dues.
